description:
Free Installation Waterman Outdoor water filter with halal active carbon / penapis air luar / 过滤水器
Waterman Outdoor filter product and installation:

Note:
*Colour of the filter may subject to variation
*(PIPE EXCEED 5FT OR INVOLVE DRILLING WORKS CONSIDER EXTRA CHARGE UP FROM RM30-120 OR MORE)
*Installation fee exclude other work such as hacking, drilling, digging, modify or customize piping, dispose old filter, add or change pipe fittings and etc.
* Penang installation covered area: Butterworth, Bukit Mertajam.
* Perak installation covered area: Tanjung malim, Teluk Intan, Sitiawan, Ipoh, Taiping, Kuala Kangsar.
* Pahang Installation covered area : Raub, Mentakab, Temerloh, Kuantan
* Terengganu installation covered area: Kuala Terengganu, Kemaman, Dungun. Paka
* For Outside Selangor and Seremban installation time will take within 10 days after order.
*SELANGOR SELECTED COVERED AREAS -->Puchong~ PJ~ Subang Jaya~ Sri Kembangan~Banting~ Ampang~ Gombak~ Selayang~ Balakong~ Rawang~ Sungai Buloh~ Subang~Kota Damansara~ Shah Alam~ Klang~ Putrajaya~ Cyberjaya~ Dengkil~ Bangi~ Sepang~ Kajang

For more information:

#6 efficient filtration layers:-
-Halal Active Carbon (with Jakim approved)
-Zeolite
-Super Fine Sand
-Fine Sand
-Coarse Sand
-Gravel

Equipped with 3 valves system which enable water
transferred smoother, faster and save maintenance
(as need not to replace cartridge monthly),
which are:
-Backwash
-Rinse
-Filter

Benefit:-
Longer the lifespan of the water dispenser / water
purifier in the house,
Save cost of replacing the water dispenser / water
purifier in house,
Washing becomes more efficient. eg. Clothes are
cleaner after wash, and
Produce clearer drinking water

Note: Water pressure is not affected after
installation.

Ciri-ciri:
Tabung diperbuat daripada bahan yang berkualiti tinggi
Tahan tekanan sehingga 100 psi
Tahan suhu sehingga 110 darjah Fahrenheit
Disediakan dengan 7 lapisan penapis yang berkualiti tinggi iaitu:-

Dilengkapi dengan 3 sistem injap pelepasan air yang memudahkan, cepat dan menjimatkan selenggaraannya (tidak perlu tukar penapis setiap bulan)
iaitu:-
1. Cuci
2. Bilas
3. Tapis

Kebaikan:-
1. Memanjangkan jangka hayat penapis air di dalam rumah,
2. Menjimatkan kos menukar penapis air di dalam rumah,
3. Menghasilkan cucian yang lebih bersih terutamanya pakaian,

Nota : Tidak mengganggu tekanan air selepas dipasang.
1. Servis Pemasangan Pantas dalam masa 24jam atau segera!!
2. Cara Pembayaran : Siap pasang baru bayar juga sedia ada.
3. Warna penapis boleh berubah-ubah, kebanyakan warna kelabu
4. Hadiah percuma diberikan sebagai tanda penghargaan, pengembalian atau penggantian tidak akan dilayan.
